# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Oil gives back Tuesday's gain as glut fears outweigh new ship attacks near Hormuz](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 25, 2026. Shipping attacks near Hormuz are moving oil for a day at a time. Brent jumped more than 2% on Tuesday after three vessels were hit, then gave back $1.35 by early Wednesday as surplus worries for 2027 returned.
- [Upstream: POSCO closes its $550 million Marcellus buy from Chord Energy](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Downstream: Dangote refinery heads for a stock listing worth about N65 trillion](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Gas and LNG: Rio Grande LNG asks to bring fuel gas into its first train](https://uticamidstream.com/#lng)
- [Gas and LNG: First storage draw of the winter is due in today's early EIA report](https://uticamidstream.com/#gas)
- [Upstream: Diversified closes its $1.8 billion Birch Permian deal](https://uticamidstream.com/#permian)
- [Cross-industry: Data centers plan more than 115 GW of their own gas plants](https://uticamidstream.com/#power)
